== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Arelius family{{!}}Arelius crest is the official symbol of Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, an ancient clan that once ruled much of the [[Rosegold continent]] under the leadership of the late Tiberian Arelius{{!}}Monarch Tiberian Arelius. The current emblem consists of a crescent moon paired with two ancient characters that signify power. This design was adapted from the personal crest of [[Ozmanthus Arelius]], the clan's [[original Patriarch]] and a renowned [[Soulsmith]]. In certain contexts, the crest is depicted with a large scythe hanging above it, which represents the symbol of the founder, Ozriel. The family's visual identity is further characterized by the use of dark blue, black, and white colors in their banners and clothing.}}
